go Components
  • draw
  • drawSource The primitive a `canvasImage` paints its source through.
  • language The `go` node of a build directive: `output { go { bubbletea() } }`.
  • shapes.canvasImage
  • shapes.canvasText
  • shapes.circle
  • shapes.ellipse
  • shapes.line
  • shapes.path
  • shapes.rect
    • Types
  • Case One arm of a `select`: a receive from c, and what to run with the value.
  • DrawContext The Go type of the draw handler's context parameter.
  • DrawEvent The primitive an override paints through.
  • SourceEvent What a `drawSource` paints a carried or fetched image with: the context, and the URL its source names.
  • chan --- Channels --- A host channel, named so a Go API that hands one out can be described at all: `*time.Ticker`'s `C` is a `<-chan Time`, and without this there is no type to declare that field as.
    • Enums
  • NativeFlag What a Go declaration's shape says beyond its name.
    • Functions
  • applyStyle The style setters, written once rather than per shape.
  • buildModule Builds the module the build wrote to dir into the binary out, and returns out.
  • closeChan
  • makeChan The element type comes from the argument, a witness declared before a call site could write a type argument: `makeChan(false)` is a `chan[bool]`.
  • recv Write one only inside the list a `select` is handed.
  • select Blocks until one arm is ready and runs exactly that one.
  • async Says a call to this function blocks, so a target that draws on one thread must not make the call there.
  • native Names the Go package-level identifier a declaration *is*.
    • Constants
  • emitted What every Go target's code declares beside a program's: `m`, the Model's receiver; `model` and `errorEvent`, which it exports as `Model` and `ErrorEvent`; and the helpers it writes.
  • imports The packages the translator imports.
  • keywords Go's keywords.
  • predeclared Go's predeclared identifiers.
